name: Auroom Mira L Outdoor Cabin Sauna Kit
description: Auroom Mira L Outdoor Cabin Sauna Kit The Auroom Mira L Outdoor Cabin Sauna Kit is meticulously designed with every detail in mind. Its full tempered glass front wall perfectly displays the luxurious thermo-aspen interior, which is enhanced by indirect LED bench lighting. The strong and durable thermally enhanced spruce exterior, available in a black wood finish, can withstand any weather conditions. The Sauna heater is sold separately. Mira's streamlined, space-saving design provides a hassle-free sauna experience, without compromising on quality. This cabin boasts an expansive design that can easily seat 5, perfect for a sauna session with friends and family. Featuring a luxurious tempered glass door and a sleek metal-wood handle, this sauna boasts a cutting-edge aesthetic Fashioned with a full tempered glass wall, the spacious interior of Auroom Mira L 5 Person Outdoor Sauna creates an airy atmosphere. Sophisticated Design. The 5-Person Outdoor Sauna boasts a luxurious interior of Thermo-aspen wood, imparting a calming and elegant atmosphere. Thermally modified black spruce cladding forms the exterior of this sauna, built to defend against diverse climate conditions. Optimized Layout. The sauna maximizes user comfort with an optimized layout that ensures the best possible use of space. Equipped with LED bench lighting which is adjustable through a remote, Auroom Mira L 5 Person Outdoor Sauna can set the perfect atmosphere for rest and relaxation. Enhance the comfort and relaxation experience with features such as a footrest and backrest with LED lighting. The L 5-Person Outdoor Sauna is equipped with a coordinating heater guard, ensuring both safety and aesthetic unity. The Auroom Mira L 5-Person Outdoor Sauna presents a contemporary aesthetic, with no visible screws or bolts on the body. Maximize your sauna time with all of the included accessories: bucket + ladle, thermometer + hygrometer, sand timer, aroma set, sauna hat, and sauna pillow.
